item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 27, 2026 - 28 messages in 4 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community server saw light-to-moderate activity over the past day, with 28 messages across four active channels. Conversation centered on server customization, self-hosting, QR tools, and Ente Photos features.

#off-topic

Members exchanged 17 messages about the server’s green theme, feature requests, and whether the new QR tool could be included in self-hosted instances. The discussion clarified that qr.ente.com has no server-side dependency, and its source is available via GitHub; duck facts and pet ducks also came up.

#photos

Nine messages covered fullscreen video sizing, self-hosted storage limits, and privacy when showing photos to friends. Members shared the CLI storage guide and the Guest View feature, while one member celebrated receiving a 1 TB SSD for an Ente self-hosting setup.

#introduce-yourself

A new member introduced themselves as a supporter of privacy and open source.

#clicks

One message offered a brief appreciation of carnations.
